text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Dober was doing some tea 
tasting at a shopping mall in search of 
black tea...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"This Darjeeling... The lingering mellow 
smoothness on the tongue and the roasty 
fragrance going down the throat are so 
pleasant..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, girl over there! Looks like my black 
tea caught your fancy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Pearl-san, you brewed this 
yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they recognized my talent and put me 
in charge of samples. My... "Tea Brewing 
That Changes the World" is receiving 
overwhelming critical acclaim!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you could brew it like 
that... Um, could you maybe teach me...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You want to seize the world too, don't 
you...! Of course! I'll teach you 
everything you need to know!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, add the tea leaves into the 
pre-warmed teapot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Putting in the tea leaves...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After pouring the hot water, put on the 
lid, and as the tea leaves steep, 
encourage them with words from all kinds 
of languages!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Words from various countries on the 
leaf... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-Dear black tea-san, and sandwich-san... 
Thank you as always for the good taste... 
XiÃ¨xie...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... to you... j-j-j... Je 
t'aaaaaaiiiiiiiiime...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, good! There was some shyness, but 
your feelings definitely got through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this really going to make it taste 
good?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, go ahead and taste it for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *gulp*... *gasp*?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that so? By showing appreciation for 
the tea leaves that traveled all the way 
from abroad—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The tea leaves steeped for just the right 
amount of time, bringing out a full, 
delicious flavor...! It's basic, but so 
important!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? And here I thought Uma 
Musume and black tea had finally crossed 
species boundaries...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well, about that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel like I've returned to my 
roots. Lately I was so flustered, I even 
forgot to let the tea leaves steep...!

The next day. Mejiro Dober was tackling 
her training with noticeably sharper 
movements!
